title: Valid National Point-of-Service Condition Codes
applicability: Applies through Variable Information Element 113, Table ID 030, and describes POS/terminal context for Segment 100 transactions.

businessRequirements.title: National POS Condition Code shall contain the source-defined ten-position structure: terminal class, presentation type, security condition, and terminal type.
Terminal class and terminal type positions shall use valid Appendix Q values consistent with the physical or digital POS channel.
Presentation positions shall correctly identify customer/card presence, mail/telephone order, preauthorization, retention capability, and re-presentment state.
Security Condition position shall use valid values for no concern, suspected fraud, verified identification, or electronic commerce digital signature.
POS Condition Code shall be consistent with Segment 100 Prompt Code, entry mode, transaction lifecycle, and eWIC/channel context.

positionModel.positions: 1-3 terminal class; 4-7 presentation type; 8 security condition; 9-10 terminal type

testCases.positive: POS condition agrees with Prompt Code and lifecycle
negative: mail/telephone condition on ordinary card-present purchase
wrong terminal context for eWIC or mPOS
